claims.text: Electric torque-fill replaces the gearbox entirely at 6.6 t.
The transmissionless premise has a MASS boundary between ~7 and 36 t: no single ratio spans cruise and grade at 36.3 t.
It has a DUTY boundary: the same truck wins +20% on stop-go and loses on regional duty.
A 2-speed under torque-fill meets a third wall - the low gear's coupling floor vs crawl speed.
At fixed gross weight, efficiency per added kilogram is the objective; every electrified semi candidate won 6-10% per km and gave 6-8% back in freight (S3 excepted).
Waste-heat recovery is a full-load technology on a part-load duty.
Zero-mass levers are symmetric; predictive energy management is worth ~0 when the incumbent gets it too.
The method: pre-registration, pre-committed kill criteria, fresh-context disk-only adjudication, three-way verification, export discipline.

No hardware was built and no physical test was run at any point in this program. The method demonstrated here catches internal inconsistency. It cannot catch wrong physics.
